scope: Read-only source audit and prospective sparse receipt design; no source changes, compile/build, runtime actions, or new capture interpretation.

facts.fact: Both workout maps omit onHoldTap, whose default is nil; BoardMap forwards nil through Optional.map. isDisplayOnly defaults false. Read-only callback status is therefore distinct from display-only picker status.

Candidate action adds BoardSimulatorPresentation to nil-callback maps. Control/reversal skip flag omits it only for nil callbacks; interactive maps still attach helper. No board identity is currently passed into PresentationView.

Window changes reset cached weak layer, viewport and attempt count. Layout and SwiftUI updates schedule the existing main-queue50ms retry, maximum120 attempts per observed viewport or cached flag reset. Successful attached layer with presentsWithTransaction=false returns early.

Matching requires positive helper bounds; converts helper bounds through UIView to window coordinates, converts CAMetalLayer bounds through CALayer to window.layer, and requires all4 differences strictly<1 point. It searches each ancestor subtree independently, accepts exactly1 match only if traversal visited<4096. Zero/multiple matches and capped traversal cannot configure.

Only success prints, after setting presentsWithTransaction=false. No existing receipt for never attached, bounds invalid, exhausted match, window detach, or cache flag observations. Empty stdout cannot distinguish buffering from missing success.

Workout model is aspect-fit within an expanding outer frame, with landscape maximum height and a0.18s highlighted-ID animation. Helper is a background on inner RealityView. There is no source guarantee that its converted viewport exactly equals the actual drawable layer bounds during host layout/animation.

concreteUnverifiedMismatchBoundaries: Helper viewport vs actual metal-layer bounds may differ because matching uses two host hierarchies; scalar delta receipts are required, not guessed tolerance changes.
Multiple same-frame metal layers in a searched ancestor reject matching; uniquely matching a frame does not prove that layer belongs to the intended board.

Configured weak layer can remain attached with false flag even if a different same-viewport drawable replaces it: current early return does not reconfirm current candidate identity. This is a source-level coverage limit, not an observed replacement.
Retry exhaustion is silent until a later viewport/flag reset.

minimalReceiptProposal.implementation: DEBUG-only FileHandle.standardError.write(contentsOf:) with one UTF8 line; no print/stdout buffering dependency, no new timer/task/subscription, no render mutation. Reuse only existing didMoveToWindow, scheduleConfiguration, configurePresentation callbacks.
events: window-attached and window-detached (before clearing weak cached state)
configured (at existing success) with property before/after
exhausted (once when attempts reaches120 after failed search)
observed-config-state change only, comparing last scalar signature in existing callbacks; exclude monotonically increasing attempt/time from dedup signature
scalarFields: event, process PID, systemUptime, helper ObjectIdentifier, optional window ObjectIdentifier
helper bounds and converted viewport x/y/w/h; window bounds; positive/finite checks
cached layer ObjectIdentifier, superlayer ObjectIdentifier or nil, presentsWithTransaction
success matched layer identity/type, layer bounds/window-frame, deltaX/deltaY/deltaWidth/deltaHeight, drawableSize, contentsScale, selected ancestor depth, visited count and candidate count
exhaustion summary: attempts, total metal candidates observed in existing traversal, minimum4-component frame deltas/identity for closest candidate, no extra hierarchy walk
minimalReceiptProposal.noStrongRetention: Diagnostic signature stores scalar text only, not layer/view/window references. Do not infer presenting-host ownership from identities or bounds.
minimalReceiptProposal.stateChangeCost: Sparse direct stderr writes can affect scheduling; both arms must use same diagnostic binary/output plumbing. Receipts establish sampled configuration, not continuous flags, drawable presentation, or causal repair.

interpretation: First determine whether helper attached and matched the actual expected workout viewport; if matched, require before/after flag and later observed state. No source-only likely framework cause or production repair is established.
